full_prompt_en: A square Renaissance-inspired painting shows a red-haired young woman in an ornate gown leaning forward into a dense garden of leaves and branches. She occupies the left and central areas in three-quarter profile, her pale face turned toward the right. Long copper curls flow down her back and around the shoulder, while smaller curls frame the forehead beneath a narrow ornamental band. Her gaze follows the raised right hand, which delicately reaches toward a thin stem near the right edge. The gown combines a softly gathered rose-pink sleeve with a dark green bodice and narrow gold trim along the neckline and waist. Folds of fabric catch warm cream highlights and descend across the lower right. Behind and above her, overlapping dark green leaves, tan branches, and pale bird-like forms crowd the background, creating a richly patterned natural enclosure. A light feathered form rises at the upper left behind her hair, partly obscured by the surrounding detail. Fine drawing defines the fingers, face, curled hair, and embroidered borders, while layered paint gives the greenery and cloth depth. The palette stays warm and muted: copper, rose, olive, cream, and brown are set against dark green shadow. Soft light comes from the upper left, illuminating her cheek, hand, and sleeve and leaving the garden recesses darker. There is no visible horizon or legible writing; the compressed foliage keeps the setting close to the figure. The overall composition is graceful and intricate, with the forward curve of the body answered by curling hair, fine branches, and luminous fabric.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形文艺复兴风格绘画呈现一名红发年轻女子身穿华丽长袍，向密集枝叶组成的花园倾身。她占据左侧与中央，以四分之三侧面朝右。长长的铜色卷发沿背与肩流下，额前小卷发藏在细装饰头带下。她的目光跟随抬起的右手，手指轻轻伸向右缘附近的一根细茎。长袍结合柔软抽褶的玫瑰粉衣袖、深绿上衣和领口与腰间的窄金边。衣料褶皱接住暖奶油色亮部，向右下方垂落。她的身后和上方，重叠的深绿叶片、棕褐枝条与浅色似鸟的形体挤满背景，形成纹样丰富的自然围合。一片浅色羽毛形状在左上方、她发后升起，部分被周围细节遮住。细致线描定义手指、面孔、卷发与刺绣边缘，层叠颜料给绿叶和布料赋予纵深。色盘温暖且柔和：铜、玫瑰粉、橄榄色、奶油色与棕色置于深绿阴影前。柔光从左上方照来，照亮脸颊、手和衣袖，花园凹处更暗。没有可见地平线或可读文字；压缩的树叶让场景贴近人物。整体构图优雅而繁复，身体向前的弯曲与卷发、细枝及发亮衣料相呼应。
style_prompt_en: Renaissance-inspired painting combines fine linear detail with softly modeled flesh, flowing fabric, and densely overlapping ornament. Copper, muted rose, olive, cream, and aged gold gather in warm layers against deep green-brown recesses. Contours stay delicate around the focal planes, while many small organic shapes fill the background without becoming a flat pattern. Directional soft light brightens exposed surfaces and lets recesses deepen gradually. Curving lines and carefully spaced highlights carry movement across a close composition. The result is graceful, tactile, and richly decorative.
style_prompt_zh: 文艺复兴风格绘画把精细线性细节与柔和塑形的平面、流动布料和密集重叠装饰结合起来。铜色、柔玫瑰色、橄榄色、奶油色与旧金色在深绿棕凹处前聚成暖色层次。焦点平面周围轮廓纤细，许多小有机形状填满背景，却不变成平板纹样。定向柔光照亮外露表面，让凹处逐渐变深。弯曲线条与精心分布的亮部引导视线穿过贴近构图。整体优雅、可触且装饰丰富。
theme_en: A red-haired woman in an ornate gown reaching toward foliage
theme_zh: 一位红发女子身着华丽长袍，伸手触向枝叶
name: Sandro Botticelli
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
